verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents hosted/pre-built integrations (Hosted Payment Page, Payment Links, Mobile SDK) and tokenized/network-token payment requests that keep raw card data off merchant servers, which is the mechanical basis for reduced PCI scope, but no evidence item explicitly states PCI DSS scope reduction or provides SAQ-A guidance. missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS scope-reduction/SAQ-A documentation, third-party PCI compliance certification evidence, and clear guidance on which integration paths (hosted vs. direct API) affect scope.
